primary_data.description: All experimental data are generated locally by the seeded mock transport (latency and failure schedules) and the scripted browser harness. No external dataset is required for the confirmatory experiments.
primary_data.generator: src/web/schedule.js and src/scroll/schedule.py (bit-identical twins); browser harness src/scroll/harness.py
primary_data.status: implemented (M2); protocol frozen 2026-11-24 (owner-approved); confirmatory runs scheduled in M3
primary_data.schedule_formula: u = fmix32-chain(seed, stream, index, field) / 2^32; delay_ms = floor(L * (1 + jitter * (2u - 1)) + 0.5); failure iff u_outcome < p
